subtitle: Your plans, saved activities and next steps.

noProjects: Your profile has no projects in this view yet.

groupsHint: These are your project memberships in the guest demo. Collaboration stays within this browser.
noMemberships: No active project membership in the demo yet.

account.title: Guest mode & account
account.unavailable: Email registration, verification, sign-in and sign-out are not connected in this version yet.
account.explain: Accounts will be coordinated with the second team's Supabase version. The demo selector only switches fictional profiles and does not sign anyone in.
account.separation: Local demo data will not automatically be assigned to a real account. Any transfer requires a deliberate, reviewed decision.

demoNotice: Guest demo · fictional data · local only
settingsIntro: Adjust your fictional profile, interests and language.

profile.onlyShared: Only voluntarily shared information appears here. Private activities and contact details are excluded from this profile.
profile.visibilityHint: The profile is visible only after activation. School, interests and project activities each require an additional voluntary choice. Posts and published content remain visible independently. Use a display name without private contact details.

fields.projects: Show published projects and memberships on profile

profile.unavailable: Extended sharing options are not yet available for this account.
profile.confirmCompletion: Check delivery and confirm project completion
profile.completionHint: Confirm only projects that have actually finished after organizational review. Interest and pending requests are not evidence of participation.

statistics.activeProjects: Current projects you take part in
statistics.hint: Calculated from associated records. Interest, requests, membership, registration and confirmed attendance are counted separately. Project completions require confirmation by moderation.
statistics.demo: These values belong only to fictional demo profiles.
statistics.impactHint: No verified totals have been published yet. Completed collaborations and participating schools will be summarized only after organizational confirmation.
